questions.question: Which of the following is NOT an input device?
questions.explanation: A Monitor is an output device — it displays information to the user. Input devices send data TO the computer: keyboard, mouse, scanner, microphone, joystick.

questions.question: What is the full form of CPU?
questions.explanation: CPU stands for Central Processing Unit. It is the brain of the computer and performs arithmetic, logical, control, and I/O operations. It contains the ALU, CU, and registers.

questions.question: Which number system uses base 16?
questions.explanation: Hexadecimal uses base 16, with digits 0-9 and letters A-F (A=10, B=11, C=12, D=13, E=14, F=15). Binary uses base 2, Octal uses base 8, Decimal uses base 10.

What is the decimal equivalent of binary number 1101?
Which of the following is volatile memory?
questions.explanation: RAM (Random Access Memory) is volatile — its contents are lost when power is switched off. ROM, Hard Disk, and CD-ROM are non-volatile and retain data without power.

questions.question: How many bytes are in 1 Kilobyte (KB)?
questions.explanation: 1 KB = 1024 bytes (2¹⁰ bytes). This is based on binary system. Similarly, 1 MB = 1024 KB, 1 GB = 1024 MB. (Note: In SI system, 1 KB = 1000 bytes, but in computing, 1024 is used.)

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of system software?
questions.explanation: System software manages computer hardware and provides a platform for application software. Examples: Operating System (Windows, Linux, macOS), device drivers, compilers. MS Word, Chrome, and VLC are application software.

questions.question: What does GUI stand for?
questions.explanation: GUI stands for Graphical User Interface. It allows users to interact with electronic devices using graphical icons and visual indicators, instead of text-based commands (CLI).

questions.question: Which logic gate outputs 1 ONLY when ALL inputs are 1?
questions.explanation: AND gate: output is 1 only when ALL inputs are 1 (1 AND 1 = 1). OR gate: output is 1 when any input is 1. NOT gate: inverts the input. NAND: AND followed by NOT.

questions.question: Which part of the CPU performs arithmetic and logical operations?
questions.explanation: The ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit) performs all arithmetic operations (add, subtract, multiply) and logical operations (AND, OR, NOT, compare). The Control Unit coordinates other units.

questions.question: What is the hexadecimal equivalent of decimal number 255?
questions.explanation: 255 in decimal = FF in hexadecimal. 255 = 15×16¹ + 15×16⁰ = FF. This is also the maximum value of a single byte (8 bits all set to 1 = 11111111₂ = FF₁₆).
